# FADEC flight mule: tables (generated by mule.py)

## 1. Rating check: the vendor claim against the donor engine's own torque

| Engine | Claim | BMEP at the claim | Implied eta_v (eta_f 0.33 / 0.30) | Donor's peak torque as BMEP | Claim / donor peak torque | Power at the claimed rpm if torque is held at the donor's peak |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Aeromomentum AM15 | 120 hp at 5,800 | 12.4 bar | 0.94 / 1.03 | 10.7 bar (128 N m) | 1.15 | 78 kW, 104 hp (an upper bound: torque falls past its peak) |
| Aeromomentum AM13 | 105 hp at 5,800 | 12.5 bar | 0.94 / 1.04 | not sourced | - | - |
| Viking 130 | 130 hp at 5,400 | 14.4 bar | 1.09 / 1.20 | 13.0 bar (154.6 N m) | 1.11 | 87 kW, 117 hp (an upper bound: torque falls past its peak) |

Reading: a naturally aspirated port-injected engine at its rated speed sits near eta_v 0.85-0.95 without tuned lengths
the vendors do not describe. The AM15 claim needs the top of that range, at a torque 15 % above the donor's own peak.
The Viking 130 claim needs eta_v above 1, 11 % above the Honda's peak torque, 1,100 rpm below the Honda's peak-power
speed. Neither is shown to be wrong; both are unmeasured. The stand measures them (G1).

## 2. What one failure leaves on a 4-cylinder with one plug per cylinder

Full throttle at the takeoff rpm; IMEP = BMEP + FMEP; FMEP band 1.5-2.2 bar [A]. BMEP is taken at the donor-consistent
figure (section 1, about 10.7 bar) and at the vendor claim (12.4 bar), so the band covers both.

| Failure | Cylinders lost (k of 4) | Brake power left, share of takeoff |
|---|---|---|
| one lane: ECU, its power feed, its crank sensor, its MAP or TPS, with automatic takeover by the other lane | 0 | 100 % |
| one coil-on-plug coil, one plug, one plug lead, or a single injector (no second injector) | 1 | 70%-72% |
| one wasted-spark coil pack (fires two cylinders): the vendor's ignition as described, if confirmed | 2 | 40%-44% |
| one injector, with a second injector per cylinder on the other lane | 0 | 100 % |

R-25 asks for at least 90 %. A dead cylinder on a geared 4-cylinder also adds half and first orders to the drive
(FL-52's method found a mesh torque reversal near 3,400 crank rpm on the Hayabusa); the Guibo coupling's stiffness is
not published, so that case is open on the AM15 until the stand survey (G3).

## 3. A second injector per cylinder: size so that either one alone carries takeoff on E15

| Engine | Takeoff power used | BSFC at takeoff [A] | Fuel, E15 | Per injector, one per cylinder | Static flow needed at 85 % duty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Aeromomentum AM15 | 120 hp | 0.32 kg/kWh | 30.5 kg/h | 171 cc/min | 201 cc/min |
| Aeromomentum AM15 | 120 hp | 0.36 kg/kWh | 34.3 kg/h | 192 cc/min | 226 cc/min |
| Aeromomentum AM13 | 105 hp | 0.32 kg/kWh | 26.7 kg/h | 149 cc/min | 176 cc/min |
| Aeromomentum AM13 | 105 hp | 0.36 kg/kWh | 30.0 kg/h | 168 cc/min | 198 cc/min |

A catalog EV14 high-impedance injector of about 250-300 cc/min at 3 bar covers it. The vendor's injector flow is not
published; at 43 psi (2.96 bar) the catalog rating applies almost unchanged.
